prose: TechCrunch reports Ghost, which makes a $3,499 computer designed for AI agents with an RTX Pro 4000 SFF Blackwell GPU, has emerged from stealth with funding. The story is about founder Zain Javaid, 19, who left quant trading after getting bored. Only the opening was read.
highlights: $3,499 computer built for AI agents with a Blackwell GPU.
